title: Forgotten Man Vanished With Millions After 10 Years
hook: Forgotten for 10 years, then vanished with millions.
script: Imagine being forgotten by your company for ten years, still getting paid, then vanishing with millions. That's exactly what happened with a man named 'Ghost Employee' in a major corporation. For an entire decade, his name remained on the payroll system after he was supposedly laid off, his direct deposits flowing without anyone noticing. He never showed up, never called, just collected a regular paycheck. When auditors finally uncovered the massive oversight, they found he had accumulated over ten million dollars. Before anyone could contact him, he disappeared without a trace, taking every cent. Can you imagine being forgotten by your company for ten years, still getting paid, then vanishing with millions?
comment: Would you have taken the money or reported it?
